Effective 1.1.26, UPS is making a change to the way that GLP-1s for Weight Loss are covered. On the $2000 Deductible HDHP Plans, weight loss drugs will no longer be covered as preventive care. This means that the cost of these prescriptions will now apply to plan deductible first. This change impacts the NonUnion Active and NonUnion pre65 Retiree Groups only. Weight loss drugs prescribed to treat diabetes are not affected by this change and will continue to be covered as they have been. If customers have questions, please direct them to Alight Health Pro at 866.455.3547.
